title: Peninsulares and criollos: the Bourbon reforms
goal: I can explain how the Bourbon reforms changed the position of the criollos.
grammar: Formal cause connectors: the Bourbon reforms

items: I can explain why many criollos lost posts and felt resentful after the Bourbon reforms.
I can explain how some criollos reached important posts before the reforms.
I can say what the Bourbon reforms changed under Charles III.
I can name some events linked to the reforms, such as the expulsion of the Jesuits.
I can use a raíz de and debido a to give a cause in formal writing.
